description:
**Repro (tmux harness, .pi/tmp/queue-test/run_faux_tui.sh)**
1. Boot the TUI against FakeTransport with a held gate.
2. Type \"first prompt\" + Enter — agent enters streaming.
3. Type \"queued one\" + Enter, \"queued two\" + Enter, \"queued three\" + Enter.
4. Observe transcript: all three queued messages render as user turns
   in the local transcript, but the agent's queue is empty (Alt+Up shows
   \"No queued messages\") and they receive no responses.

**Root cause (apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex)**
do_handle_submit/3 (around L1411-1428) unconditionally calls:
\`\`\`elixir
Task.start(fn -> Coder.prompt(session, value, send_text) end)
\`\`\`
without checking whether the agent is already streaming. Coder.prompt
delegates to OctoPi.Agent.prompt which returns {:error, :already_streaming},
but the Task.start fork discards the return. Meanwhile the TUI appends
the user message to its own transcript regardless.

**Upstream behavior (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts L987-997)**
\`\`\`ts
if (this.isStreaming) {
  if (!options?.streamingBehavior) {
    throw new Error(\"Agent is already processing. Specify streamingBehavior…\");
  }
  if (options.streamingBehavior === \"followUp\") {
    await this._queueFollowUp(expandedText, currentImages);
  } else {
    await this._queueSteer(expandedText, currentImages);
  }
  ...
  return;
}
\`\`\`
Upstream routes Enter-while-streaming through steer() (default) or followUp()
(Alt+Enter / handleFollowUp).

**Fix sketch**
- In do_handle_submit/3 (and Coder.prompt itself if needed), check
  agent streaming state. If streaming, route to Coder.steer/2 (default)
  or Coder.follow_up/2 (Alt+Enter handler at L1228 already exists).
- Keep the local transcript update so the user sees their message,
  but tag it visually as \"queued\" rather than as a settled turn
  (see opi-tze.3 for the pending-indicator UX).

Note: opi-tze.1 (steering drain bug) must also be fixed for steered
messages to actually be processed once routed correctly.
title: [BUG] TUI Enter while streaming calls Coder.prompt; messages silently lost
